title: Bridging the Gap: What Real Apps Do

blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
Bridging the Gap: What Real Apps Do
Our Journal app doesn't reflect how real apps work. After all, real apps:

items: Load data from a server, not from a form.
Include features like search, filtering, and pagination.
Possess UI patterns like drawers and modals that need direct access to the DOM.
Organize all of that logic so it doesn't pile up inside a single component.

blocks.content: That's what this course is about. You'll pick up the same Daily Journal App and modify it — using React Hooks.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
